title: Desert Dream Machine
description: A steampunk-style machine with a large screen displays a girl with mechanical goggles and raised hands, positioned inside a derelict wooden room filled with sand. Behind it, a chalkboard reads 'NOX GAB' surrounded by anarchy symbols, while an open wall reveals a surreal desert landscape with sand dunes, a large red sun, and a purple twilight sky.
prompt: A detailed surreal scene of a vintage steampunk machine with brass pipes and gears sitting in a derelict wooden room overtaken by sand dunes. The machine's large screen shows a girl wearing mechanical goggles with one large yellow lens, her hands pressed against the glass. A chalkboard behind reads 'NOX GAB' with crossed out symbols and anarchy signs. Through a broken wall, a vast desert with rolling dunes stretches under a dramatic red sun setting on the horizon in a purple and orange twilight sky.
